description: This file implements data structures and functions for managing MIME type glob patterns, including hash trees and list management, for file type identification based on filename patterns.

classes.name: XdgGlobHash
classes.description: Hash structure for storing glob patterns categorized as literal, simple, or full patterns.

classes.name: XdgGlobHashNode
classes.description: Node in the hash tree representing a character in the pattern, with associated MIME type and children.

classes.name: XdgGlobList
classes.description: Linked list for storing glob pattern data entries.

methods.name: _xdg_glob_list_free
methods.description: Frees a glob list and its children.

methods.name: _xdg_glob_list_append
methods.description: Appends a new pattern to the glob list if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: _xdg_glob_hash_insert_ucs4
methods.description: Inserts a pattern in the hash tree using UCS4 encoding.

methods.name: _xdg_glob_hash_insert_text
methods.description: Inserts a pattern in the hash tree from UTF-8 text.

methods.name: _xdg_glob_hash_node_lookup_file_name
methods.description: Looks up MIME types associated with a filename in the hash tree.

methods.name: compare_mime_weight
methods.description: Comparator for sorting MIME types by weight.

methods.name: ascii_tolower
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase ASCII.

methods.name: _xdg_glob_hash_lookup_file_name
methods.description: Main function to lookup MIME types for a filename, considering literals, hash patterns, and glob patterns.

methods.name: _xdg_glob_hash_new
methods.description: Creates a new glob hash structure.

methods.name: _xdg_glob_hash_free
methods.description: Frees the entire glob hash structure.

methods.name: _xdg_glob_determine_type
methods.description: Determines if a glob pattern is literal, simple, or full.

methods.name: _xdg_glob_hash_append_glob
methods.description: Adds a glob pattern to the hash structure based on its type.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_glob_read_from_file
methods.description: Reads glob patterns and MIME types from a file into the hash structure.
